Section I of the exam

Multiple choice

60 questions, drawn from all five units and the three skill categories. The AP Cybersecurity practice exam gives you scored questions with explanations. The exam format page has the full breakdown of how the exam is built.

A question a day, and the whole bank when you want itQuestion of the DayOne question for everyone each day, a random draw when you want more, and every question browsable by unit and topic. Section II of the exam

Free response

One Device Security Analysis, parts A to E, 50 minutes. Full practice questions in the exam's exact format, each with sample responses and credit points. More on the format and what each part asks: the FRQ practice hub.
